caption:
the seven o'clock pilates slot is the one nobody wants, so it's mine
empty studio, that light for about ten minutes, then everyone arrives

posting last week all at once. i take a lot of these and do nothing with them
alt: An empty pilates studio floor early in the morning. One mat is unrolled with a towel and a water bottle dropped on it, a bag lies on its side, and rolled mats and foam rollers line the wall. A hard band of low sun lies across the scuffed pale wood.
note: Carries the backlog line. Said once, plainly, so the dates are explained rather than left to be noticed. LIVE version is 6df563, not the newer 2e87f4 — the newer one is flatter and was not worth a repost.

caption:
sat down at one to finish a deck, it's four now
the coffee is from two

working from a seoul flat is mostly this. the light was better than anything i made on it
alt: A small dining table at the end of a working afternoon: a closed laptop, a mug with a dried coffee ring inside it, a charger cable running off the edge, an electric fan on the floor. Low sun lies across the table. A bare knee and foot are at the bottom edge of the frame.
note: No location: she does not geotag her own flat. The newer render 4d8021 IS better than this live one, but not by enough to justify archiving a post that already has engagement on it.

caption:
jieun didn't want to go home so we stayed in euljiro until they stacked the chairs around us
i was talking myself into teaching my first pilates class on wednesday
she took this mid-sentence, which is the only way i ever look normal

what did you make yourself do this week
alt: A woman sits at a small cafe table in the evening, caught mid-word with one hand raised in a gesture, looking just past the camera. A tall glass sits in front of her and a second one nearer the lens. Other occupied tables and a service counter are behind her.
note: The question is the engagement lever: sends and comments outweigh likes for reaching non-followers, and this one is answerable by anyone who does not care about her yet.

caption:
taught it

one cue came out backwards and i corrected it out loud and the room just carried on, which is the exact thing i'd been scared of since february
this is the face of having nothing left. it went fine
alt: A woman sits on a mat in a pilates studio just after a class, one arm stretched out toward the phone, the other hand flat on the mat. Her hair is coming loose and her face is flushed and blank. Two other women are on mats behind her and a white towel lies on the floor beside her.
note: Pays off the previous post's line about talking herself into it. DO NOT write it as a win — the picture is a blank face, and a triumphant caption over an empty expression is the mismatch people feel without being able to name it.

caption:
eleven hours later, downstairs, standing in front of the freezer deciding between two things i would eat either way
caught myself in the glass and thought, fine, actually

what's your 11pm shop order
alt: A woman takes a selfie in a brightly lit convenience store late at night, one arm out toward the phone. Shelves of instant noodles and snacks run down one side, a freezer cabinet and a bin are on the other, and the floor is pale tile.
note: No location — it is the shop under her building, and she did not geotag the flat. No business tag either: the brand is visible in the frame, which is fine, but tagging it implies an affiliation that does not exist.
Posted at the OLDER market render (ace1f9), not d71afd.  The peaches. Pairs with n_street_bag and the two should stay a pair — same afternoon, twenty-five minutes apart.

caption:
bought peaches i did not need and then walked up the hill with them, because that seemed reasonable at the bottom of the hill
thirty-four degrees. the bag is winning
alt: A woman takes a selfie standing in the shade on a narrow residential street in Seoul, one arm out toward the phone, a plastic bag of fruit in her other hand. Her mouth is pressed flat and her eyebrows are up. The sunlit road behind her is burnt out white. Air-conditioning units and parked scooters line the wall.
note: Pairs with the market post — the bag holds those peaches. No location: it is her own street. Do not caption it as cute; the picture is a face regretting a decision, and 'the bag is winning' is what matches it.

caption:
walked the river after and the sun did the thing it does behind the bridge
everybody in seoul has this photo. this one is mine
alt: The Han river in Seoul at sunset from the riverside path. The low sun is going down behind a bridge and the water is burnt out to white and glittering underneath it. Cyclists and walkers are on the path, a metal railing crosses the foreground, and apartment towers stand on the far bank.
note: She is not in this one and the caption must not pretend she is. 'Everybody has this photo, this one is mine' earns the cliche instead of apologising for it.

caption:
칼국수 before three days of course, which start at nine tomorrow
ate it too fast to take a second picture
alt: A bowl of hand-cut noodle soup steaming on a steel table in a small late-night noodle shop in Seoul, with kimchi and pickled radish in small metal side dishes, a stainless cup of water and a napkin dispenser beside it. One forearm comes in from the edge of the frame holding steel chopsticks over the bowl.
note: IMAGE STILL BLANK — needs the rebuilt prompt run first.

caption:
jieun turns 27 today so i found the dress
this is not a smile, this is me deciding whether it works
alt: A full-length mirror selfie in the narrow hallway of a small Seoul flat in the evening. A woman in a short black dress holds her phone in front of her chest, eyes slightly narrowed and mouth closed. Shoes are left out by the door, a coat hangs on a hook, and a laundry rack is just visible through a doorway.
note: No location: it is her own hallway. Crop anchor stays 0.35 — the default 0.70 takes the top of her head off.

caption:
home before midnight because i have practice hours in the morning, so i went up to the roof instead of inside
put the phone on the ledge, walked over, stood there waiting for the timer like a person with no dignity left

worth it for the dress
alt: A woman stands full length on the roof of an apartment building in Seoul near midnight in a short black dress with a small shoulder bag. Water tanks, a satellite dish, ducting and a drying rack surround her, with the lit windows of low buildings behind. The frame is dark, grainy and slightly off level.
note: IMAGE STILL BLANK — needs the rebuilt prompt run first. The caption does the work the old render was trying to do with lighting: it admits the phone was propped, which is what makes a posed frame honest.

caption:
last one from that week. seoul forest, an hour of doing almost nothing, jieun saying something about the exam

the only photo of me in seven days where i look happy, and i look terrible in it. keeping it
alt: A woman sits on the grass in a park in Seoul in the late afternoon, taking a selfie mid-laugh with her eyes creased shut and her head tipped back. Trees and apartment blocks are behind her in warm low sun.
note: Closes the backlog — the first caption said she was posting last week all at once, and this says so is finished. From here she posts in something like real time.

caption:
the seven o'clock slot means the platform is empty and the light does that thing for about four minutes

first morning in five weeks i wasn't already sweating
alt: An empty subway platform at Seongsu station early in the morning, glass screen doors along the edge, tiled wall, empty metal seats, Korean signage and a lit route map.
note: Mon 07:35 · Seongsu platform, first cool morning. No face.

caption:
checking whether the leggings have gone see-through at the back, which is the actual reason anyone takes this photo

they had not. this time
alt: A mirror selfie in the small changing room of a pilates studio. A woman in black leggings and a sports bra holds her phone at chest height, a zip-up over one arm. Lockers, a bench with a bag, a folded towel.
note: Mon 08:50 · changing room mirror. Anchor 0.35 — mirror selfies sit high.

caption:
it rained properly for the first time since june and i turned the fan off at the wall like it was a ceremony

did no work for ten minutes. worth it
alt: A small table by an open window in a Seoul flat while it rains. An open laptop, a glass of water, a notebook and pen. An electric fan sits switched off on the floor. Wet rooftops outside.
note: Tue 15:20 · THE FAN IS OFF. That is the whole photograph.

caption:
second class

nobody tells you the second one is worse in a different way — the first one you survive, the second one you have to actually be good at
it was fine. someone asked a question i could answer
alt: A woman sits on the floor of a pilates studio after teaching, taking a selfie at arm's length. Black sports bra and leggings, hair coming loose, flushed. Reformer frames and another woman putting her shoes on behind her.
note: Wed 14:40 · second class. Must NOT read as triumphant.

caption:
half nine at night in the coin laundry because of this morning

forty minutes of doing nothing, which i have not done in a while. i am not going to pretend i hated it
alt: The inside of a small coin laundry late at night. A row of washing machines, one running, a plastic basket on a folding counter with a paperback on top, a detergent vending machine, Korean signs on the wall.
note: Wed 21:30 · coin laundry. Least curated thing all week.

caption:
jieun's birthday is tomorrow and i stood in front of this tray for genuinely four minutes

got the 6,000 won one. obviously
alt: The counter of a small neighbourhood bakery in the late afternoon. Trays of bread and pastries under warm light, metal tongs resting on a tray, handwritten Korean price cards, a glass case at the till.
note: Thu 17:10 · buying tomorrow's thing. No face.

caption:
jieun turned 27 and instead of a restaurant we bought beer at the gs25 and sat on the steps like students

best thing i have done all month and it cost four thousand won
alt: A woman sits on the wide concrete steps beside the Han river in the evening, turned to talk with one hand mid-gesture, looking past the camera. A can and an open bag of snacks beside her, the river and a lit bridge behind.
note: Fri 19:40 · Jieun's birthday on the Han steps. Friend-taken.

caption:
no course this weekend so sunday is laundry, something on the hob, and writing down the week

the flat is a normal temperature for the first time since june and i am weirdly happy about it
alt: A woman takes a selfie at arm's length in the small kitchen area of a one-room flat late on a Sunday morning. Hair unbrushed, an oversized washed-out t-shirt, no makeup, mouth open mid-sentence. A pot on the hob, a drying rack, a laundry rack through the doorway.
note: Sun 11:00 · the reset. Unbrushed, good mood about a Sunday.

caption:
it has been making the noise since july and i have been pretending not to hear it

nine in the morning. there is a towel involved
alt: A small washing machine in the corner of a one-room flat, door open with wet washing inside, a puddle across the floor, a towel thrown down at the edge of it and a bottle of detergent knocked over.

caption:
6,000 won and it tastes like a rumour of coffee

posting this so i remember not to go back
alt: An iced americano in a tall plastic cup on a small marble table outside a cafe, ice melted to a pale layer at the top, a paper straw going soft, a phone face down and keys beside it. A narrow street behind.

caption:
went in for freezer bags

the sponge is a strawberry. i do not want to talk about it
alt: A flat lay on a pale wood floor of things bought at a Daiso: grey grip socks still on their tag, two black hair claws, three stacked plastic containers, a roll of freezer bags, a kitchen sponge shaped like a strawberry, and a curled receipt.
